newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News names Post's Breindel senior VP.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News names Post's Breindel senior VP.

text.p: News Corp Ltd chief executive and chairman Rupert Murdoch said on Thursday that Eric Breindel, the editorial page editor of The New York Post, had been appointed a senior vice president of News Corp.
Breindel would focus on strategic policy and planning for News Corp, Murdoch said in a statement.
"We look forward to bringing Mr Breindel's wide-ranging talents into News Corp's global operations where he will play a major role in strategic policy," Murdoch said.
Breindel would continue to write a weekly column for the Post. He would also moderate a new weekly public affairs television programme on the Fox News Channel which would focus on media bias.
